notes: The bracketed article [הַ] assimilated into laṭṭôb is a real token (rule 12) and takes the substantival pronoun whom under rule 41, the adjective keeping best.

bəʿênêhem is read as a rule 30/40 fusion (think) with the suffix taking the subject pronoun they, exactly as rule 40 reads ʾim-raʿ bəʿênêkā → if it displease thee; the alternative leaving the bet unrepresented is named in that unit's note.
